src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/export_jobs.py

Python · Tier A

Own cancellable export jobs and short-lived private download files.

Responsibilities

  • Serialize export work, retain progress/status and protect files while downloads hold reader references.

Boundaries

  • The export writer owns snapshot/encoding logic; job status does not certify application release or recovery.

Lifecycle

  • Start one job, create a private output, check cancellation before ready publication, then reap expired downloads.

State

  • One app-owned worker and locks protect jobs; stop joins the worker before runtime ownership can be released.

Security

  • Outputs use private temporary directories/files; cancellation wins publication races and errors expose bounded messages.

Collaborators

  • export_progress tracks heartbeat/cancellation; lifecycle owns private root/timing metadata; write_export creates backup content.

Public surface

  • start/get/cancel expose job lifecycle; acquire_download/release_download bracket file use; stop settles worker ownership.

@see src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/export_progress.py

@see src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/lifecycle.py

src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/export_progress.py

Python · Tier A

Track bounded export progress, heartbeat and cancellation without payload disclosure.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain phase totals, sampled work rates and validated timing history for export status estimates.

Boundaries

  • Only fixed labels and numeric measurements escape; backup bodies and credentials are not telemetry.

Lifecycle

  • Writers check the lease at work boundaries, update phases and expose copied status through snapshot.

State

  • An RLock protects measurements; the owning job renews heartbeat and signals the cancellation event.

Security

  • Expired heartbeat cancels work; stale or insufficient measurements withhold a remaining-time estimate.

Collaborators

  • export_jobs owns job lifetime; export_writer reports writing progress; valid_history bounds retained timing profiles.

Public surface

  • ExportProgress.check enforces cancellation; inventory/update record work; snapshot/profile project measurements.

@see src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/export_jobs.py

@see src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/export_writer.py

src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/export_writer.py

Python · Tier A

Write canonical buffered JSON while hashing the payload once.

Responsibilities

  • Emit sorted-key ASCII backup JSON and compute payload_sha256 during the payload write.

Boundaries

  • The writer does not select records, capture snapshots or own the supplied output stream lifetime.

Lifecycle

  • Split envelope/collection fragments, enforce the existing byte limit, flush buffers and return filename/size.

State

  • A bounded byte buffer and digest belong to the call; nested large strings are encoded in fragments.

Security

  • Cancellation checks occur at append boundaries; exceeding backup size raises BackupError before further writes.

Collaborators

  • data_transfer.encode defines canonical JSON; export_progress receives existing writing updates.

Public surface

  • fragments yields canonical bytes; write_document writes the envelope with its computed payload digest.

@see src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/init.py

@see src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/export_progress.py

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
fragments 38 Use the C encoder for individual records, not Python iterencode per scalar. Splitting the envelope/collections bounds temporary copies while preserving exactly encode()'s sorted keys, separators, ASCII escaping and array order.
write_document 75 @brief Stream the canonical document with its payload digest, enforcing cancellation/size and returning filename and byte count.

src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/generation_import.py

Python · Tier A

Offline full-generation replacement under the already acquired Server owner.

Details

Canonical databases are never overwritten. Managed file replacement is journaled before it starts; manifest publication commits the complete import. An interrupted pre-commit attempt restores the previous files. Verified publication retires the old generation and temporary rollback files. No runtime worker has started here.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
_preflight_space 36 Budget additional copies per filesystem before replacing managed files. This is a conservative preflight, not a reservation. ENOSPC can still race it; the import journal remains responsible for recovery in that case. Existing generations and the already materialized staging tree stay intact.
_recover 85 @brief Require the journal to match local destinations and hub ownership, then compare its generation with the published manifest. Verify committed data or restore the previous managed files, publish the outcome, remove staging/journal markers and retire superseded generations and temporary originals. Path mismatch or verification failure preserves the unresolved recovery boundary.
apply_pending 142 @brief Require the current-process exclusive BOOTSTRAPPING owner before repositories are installed. Resolve interrupted generation or legacy journals, revalidate a pending document, preflight storage and construct a verified generation. Journal managed-file replacement before publishing manifest.json; recovery uses that publication as the commit boundary even when an exception follows it.

src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/lifecycle.py

Python · Tier A

Stage imports for the next startup; journal multi-store replacement and recovery.

Details

No live database is replaced by an HTTP request. Startup applies before any store, runtime, cache or worker opens. An interrupted installation rolls back on next boot.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
root 40 @brief Resolve the private transfer directory beside the configured current-run database path. Create it with private permissions only when requested; status and bootstrap probes can inspect without creating storage.
write_json 76 @brief Encode metadata to a same-directory temporary file, fsync its bytes, atomically replace the target and sync the parent. Always remove a leftover temporary path; I/O failures propagate to the staging or recovery owner.
read_json 92 @brief Decode retained transfer metadata with room for its bounded backup document plus wrapper fields. Invalid or oversized content raises the existing strict decode error.
status 99 @brief Report whether pending.json exists, whether restart is required and any last-result record. This is staged intent/result metadata, not a claim that imported stores are already active.
preview 115 @brief Under the transfer lock, reject an existing pending import, validate/materialize the document in an isolated temporary tree and atomically replace the preview record with a new token. A later successful preview supersedes the earlier token; validation failures leave live data unchanged.
confirm 138 @brief Under the transfer lock, require no existing pending import and an exact current preview token. Atomically rename preview.json to pending.json, sync the directory and return restart-required status. Data replacement belongs to offline startup.
cancel 155 @brief Remove preview and pending metadata under the transfer lock unless a legacy install journal exists. Sync directory changes and return status; current generation replacement is coordinated by the exclusive offline startup owner.
retire_history 219 Retire private import copies only after their recovery journal is resolved.
apply_pending 279 @brief Apply or recover the legacy canonical-file import protocol before stores open. Resolve an existing committed/uncommitted journal first; otherwise revalidate staging, copy all originals before journaling, install prepared targets and run preflight before marking commit. Current Server generation imports use the separate generation_import owner.

src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/memory_transfer.py

Python · Tier A

Deliberate operator snapshots of the complete immutable Controller revision.

Details

Materialization uses private SQLite files under the existing owner. The running Server continues using its RAM roots; exporter I/O holds no runtime transaction lock and never reads the stale canonical databases. This is an explicit backup operation, not a runtime cache fill or an awaited write-behind checkpoint.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
export_snapshot 18 @brief Require the complete application domain inventory, capture one immutable RAM revision and materialize each domain into private temporary SQLite files under recovery access. Pass those files, separately inventoried managed bodies and the snapshot identity to the portable encoder. Progress checks cooperate with cancellation; temporary files are removed on exit. Runtime repositories keep their RAM roots and no checkpoint is published.
validate_snapshot_envelope 81 @brief Validate the exact snapshot-envelope shape, epoch/revision types and complete store-to-domain mapping against the current application inventory. Reject partial or mismatched authorities before restore; this check does not install any records or files.

src/agent_runtime/data_transfer/stores.py

Python · Tier A

Closed inventory of portable application stores and destination schema owners.

Details

Wire collection names are stable. Rename/migrate records here when storage changes; never execute schema or SQL supplied by a backup.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
paths 26 Not yet documented
initialize 46 Build fresh current schemas without touching live stores or starting workers.
tables 122 Exclude only metadata and reproducible SQLite virtual/search indexes.
migrate_records 131 Explicit wire-version adapter boundary, independent of SQLite schema numbers. Keep accepting version 1 when adding nullable/defaulted columns or new collections. For renamed/removed fields or changed JSON semantics, add a versioned adapter here with a retained fixture before changing the writer's wire version.
